name: Lag Reducer
description: Optional particle rendering reduction with an on/off switch and adjustable strength.

enabled.name: Enable particle optimization
enabled.description: Master switch. Disable this to render particles normally.

particle-draw-reduction.name: Particle draw reduction
particle-draw-reduction.description: 0 = off; 1-4 skip 1 in every 2-5 particle draw calls. Stronger values may hide visual cues or cause flicker.
